# QR-code generator

Vendored qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT license.
Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/2.0.4
The original copyright and license header is preserved in qrcode.js.
Codes use automatic version selection, correction level M and a quiet zone of four modules. SVG is generated in the visitor's browser; no URL or product information is sent to a QR provider.

## PDF rendering

html-to-image 1.11.13, MIT. Source: https://github.com/bubkoo/html-to-image
Original license: html-to-image-LICENSE. Vendored locally; no CDN required.
